rationale: PULP_DEV_SHARED_UI adds a development-only link mode for plug-in modules (a shared Pulp runtime dylib in the build tree, a linker launcher, and post-link steps moved to existing build edges), refuses such builds on every ship path, and lets pulp dev/loop default to it in SDK projects. The range also carries the parent branch's raw-read control-shipping scan and the create-template SOURCES split. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves: the static artifacts the ship paths accept are unchanged, and dev-shared artifacts are refused before any signing or packaging.
